title: WPMB/208/2003 of MANMOHAN KUMAR Vs M.D.D.A. and ORS.

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (M/B) No. 208 of 2003
Shri Man Mohan Kumar .......... Petitioner.
V e r s u s
Mussoorie Dehradun Development
Authority and another .......... Respondents.
None appears on behalf of the petitioner.
Mr. V.K. Kohli, Senior Advocate with Ms. Puja Banga, Advocate for the respondents.
 Date of Judgment: 07.12.2010
JUDGMENT
Coram: Hon'ble Barin Ghosh, C.J.
 Hon'ble V.K. Bist, J.
BARIN GHOSH, C.J. (ORAL)

Even on the second call, none appears on behalf of the petitioner.
The matter has been remanded by the Hon'ble Supreme Court for
reconsideration. Petitioner succeeded in the first round of litigation, but
lost before the Hon'ble Supreme Court, when the Hon'ble Supreme Court
remanded the matter back to this Court.
2. On the last occasion too none appeared on behalf of the petitioner.
We feel that in as much as the petitioner did not keep his part of the
obligation in relation to allotment made by not tendering and paying the
amounts he was required to pay, we think that the petitioner has lost
interest in the writ petition.
3. The writ petition is, accordingly, dismissed for non-prosecution.
